from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class LegalDocument(BaseModel):
    """A single legal document with metadata required to identify its administrative nature and subject."""
    title: str = Field(description="The full official title of the court document")
    case_nature: str = Field(description="The legal nature of the case (e.g., '行政诉讼', '民事', '执行')")
    administrative_domain: str | None = Field(description="If administrative, the specific management domain (e.g., '民政', '劳动', '房屋征收'). None if not administrative.")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific cause of action or legal dispute described in the document")
    key_parties: str | None = Field(description="The administrative defendant or key parties mentioned")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[LegalDocument]
